'''Ulldin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], onboard a ''Defender''-class light corvette over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomen Karr]]'s [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jaesa Willsaam]] rashly contacted the future [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], an apprentice to [[Darth Baras]] after the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] killed Master [[Yonlach]] and her parents. However, Karr discovered her plan and talked her out of it, sending [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] Ulldin and [[Zylixx]] in her place to wait for the Sith and end the threat.<ref name="The Plan is Working" />

When the Sith boarded the ship, Ulldin and Zylixx stood ready. Ulldin warned the Warrior that he could not prevail against two Jedi Knights and demanded that the Sith surrender. Zylixx, however, expected the Warrior to engage them in battle, as all the Sith they had faced did. Rather than draw his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the Warrior chose to goad Zylixx into giving into his anger and lash out, forcing Ulldin's hand. The two Knights engaged the Sith in a duel, but were easily defeated. Zylixx was the first to die when he was nearly close to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], leaving Ulldin badly injured. Ulldin expressed shock at how his friend was unbalanced and at how the Sith was quickly able to goad him. The Warrior proclaimed the fate that awaited all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was either to fall into darkness or to fall to a Sith's blade. Ulldin promised that Karr would prove those words false and readied himself for death and became [[Force ghost/Legends|one with the Force]] as the Wrath slew him.<ref name="The Plan is Working" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ulldin is a character in the 2011 ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Chapter I of the Sith Warrior's storyline.<ref name="The Plan is Working" />

===Fate===
Depending on the player's choices, Ulldin's fate can be decided many different ways:<ref name="The Plan is Working" />
*If the Wrath chooses light side dialogues, Ulldin would feel unsure that the Sith intends Willsaam harm, despite Zylixx's insistence that they must end the threat, and departs, leaving Zylixx to face the Sith alone.<ref name="The Plan is Working" />
*If the Wrath goads Zylixx into giving into his anger, kills him and wounds Ulldin, the Sith can choose to spare the latter (light side dialogue) or execute him (dark side dialogue).<ref name="The Plan is Working" />
